name: reactor-next-4-right
description: #77 (diagnostic, exit search): from after-battle, hold right (no Circle) until g_FieldCurrentMap differs from md1stin (0x74): next_wait is the frames that took, 0 on a 60 s timeout. Then until g_IsFieldLoading reads 2 again (settle_wait; it read 2 in a settled field), and 120 frames more. Reports the field ID candidates: the documented next field is md1_1 = 0x75 (ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID).
